name: benzonitrile_g_label_2026-11-20
purpose: TASKS 211, GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-20_Anharmonic_Step_Substituted_Molecule.md, part B: the label the anharmonic step is trained against, for benzonitrile (13 atoms, not among x2*'s 37 training molecules) - the B3LYP/6-31G* quartic force field at grid 75,302 from the pipeline run's geometry (corpus B_3100da3761) by probes/s1_anharmonic_level.sh, as probes/s2_batch.sh ran it for every training molecule, then probes/gvpt2_labels.py --setting G (probes/g_label_for_step.sh). 67 Hessians. probes/anharmonic_step_label_read.py then reads the step's printed shifts of 19 Nov against this label, per family beside the printed bar. A NOISY field ends the run with its marker and part B is not read. Nothing new is called except PYSCF_MAX_MEMORY (pyscf/__config__.py), which sets block sizes only
command: env CAP_MB=4096 THREADS=4 bash ../../anharmonic_substituted.sh g-label benzonitrile modules/05_support_predictor/corpus/molecules/B_3100da3761/geometry.json probes/results_m1/anharmonic_step_substituted_2026-11-20/g_label

estimate.basis: S2's fit of seconds per displaced Hessian at 5 server threads, exp(-4.92) x n^3.89 (PreRegistration_2026-10-19_S2b_Learning_Curve.md), gives 157 s at 13 atoms; phenylacetylene (14 atoms) measured 225-235 s (s2_anharmonic_2026-10-18/s2/A_a848c04a21.log). 67 Hessians x 157 s = 2.9 h on a server; the laptop at 4 threads beside the training search is ASSUMED 1-3 times that (not measured; the GFN2-xTB field of this molecule took 2.8 times longer beside the search), so 3-9 h, plus the optimisation. The first displaced Hessian prices the run: over 1800 s the runner stops (MAX_FIRST, as probes/s2_batch.sh)

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run's process tree at 4096 MB (CAP_MB), with pyscf's max_memory at half of it. No pyscf Hessian of a 13-atom molecule has a recorded peak on the laptop; the corpus job of this molecule in this basis (psi4, optimisation and two analytic Hessians) peaked at 1.71 and 1.9 GB (corpus/molecules/{B,A}_3100da3761/result.json, peak_rss_gb), and one process computes one Hessian at a time here. A kill at the cap prints KILLED and the run resumes at a higher cap once memory is free. With the training search (7.7 GB) this makes 11.7 of the 13 GB budget, so it starts only after the DFT measurement of TASKS 218 (4.0 GB) has ended and not beside part A's field
